caption: AI hype often outpaces real results. This carousel lays out five practical prompts to test hype against usefulness in your business. Use them to separate buzz from payoff and keep decisions grounded. Which prompt will you try first? #AIforBusiness #Productivity #AIPrompts

slides.title: Hype vs usefulness?
slides.body: See what actually works in practice. Try these 5 prompts.

slides.title: 1. Quick ROI
slides.body: Estimate ROI for [idea] over [time]; return ROI, payback period, and a go/no-go verdict.

slides.title: 2. Task automation
slides.body: Map [task] into AI steps; output a two-week automation plan with milestones and success metrics.

slides.title: 3. Risk & ethics
slides.body: Identify ethical, legal, and privacy risks for [idea]; provide mitigations and a compliance checklist.

slides.title: 4. Hype vs Usefulness
slides.body: Compare claims vs actual results for [idea]; output a short verdict and 2 concrete tests to run.

slides.title: 5. Decision criteria
slides.body: List criteria to stop or scale [idea]; assign weights and a go/no-go threshold.

slides.title: Final takeaway
slides.body: Takeaway: test hype with real prompts. Save this post and follow @naelbuildingbig.
